## Team-X v3.5.0: every switch does what it says

This release is about **trust**. In v3.4.0, many settings and features looked live but did nothing. In v3.5.0 every switch does what its label says, every refusal tells you why, and every model call counts against your budget.

### Highlights

- **Privacy tiers are enforced, not just displayed.** Every model call, embedding and external runtime is checked against Settings → Privacy at the moment it runs:
  - Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and command runtimes count as Proprietary Cloud.
  - An HTTP runtime counts as Local only on your own network.
  - A provider above your tier is refused with a reason and is never silently swapped for another.
  - The Privacy panel lists who is affected before anything runs.
- **Copilot answers from your company's own knowledge.** It searches your messages, tickets, meeting minutes and vault files. Long-term memory and the knowledge graph now survive restarts, and every Enhanced AI switch takes effect.
- **The Models tab.** Run GGUF models through a bundled llama.cpp, browse and download from Hugging Face with pause and resume, connect LM Studio, Ollama or vLLM servers on your network, and benchmark real throughput.
- **Work that finishes:**
  - The command palette classifies what you type with a model.
  - Meetings write minutes and file their action items as tickets.
  - The Hire dialog offers all 55 roles.
  - Proactive Mode works per company.
  - A failed turn tells you why.
- **The Linux AppImage needs no FUSE 2.** It now embeds AppImage's static runtime and starts on a stock Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 desktop ([#16](https://github.com/Git-Rocky-Stack/Team-X/issues/16)).

### Upgrade notes

- **Privacy:** if your tier was below an employee's cloud provider, that employee now stops with a clear refusal instead of quietly using the cloud. Settings → Privacy shows who is affected.
- **Search index:** Semantic Chunking now applies to the search index. Run **Settings → Retrieval → Rebuild** once to re-chunk existing content.
- **Database:** migration `0037` (long-term memory and knowledge graph) runs automatically on first launch.
- **Removed:** the `team-x-ai` command-line tool, whose output was not real, and the Streaming, Multi-Turn Planning, Max Tokens and Temperature settings, which nothing applied.
